seo.title: Facilities & Services · Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital, Kochi
seo.description: 5G Smart Ambulance, 24/7 emergency, ICU, operation theatres, blood bank, dialysis, diagnostics, pharmacy, insurance & TPA support and an on-campus canteen at IGCH, Kochi.

hero.lead: Along with medical and surgical specialities, the hospital offers a range of facilities to support patients through emergency care, diagnosis, treatment and recovery.

ambulance.heading: 5G Smart Ambulance
ambulance.subheading: Emergency care, even before reaching the hospital.
ambulance.body: IGCH's 5G Smart Ambulance connects patients with the hospital's emergency team while they are still on the road. Patient vitals and medical information can be shared during transit, helping the team prepare for the patient's arrival.

head.heading: Emergency, ICU, theatres and blood bank - all day, every day.

items.title: Emergency & Critical Care
items.subtitle: 24-hour emergency care in Kochi.
items.body: IGCH's Emergency Medicine department provides medical attention to patients requiring urgent assessment and treatment. The emergency team is available round the clock.

items.title: Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
items.subtitle: Close monitoring and specialised care for critically ill patients.
items.body: The ICU provides continuous monitoring and medical support for patients who require intensive care. The critical care team manages patients who need close observation and specialised treatment.
items.note: [ICU types, bed capacity and available facilities to be confirmed by the hospital.]

items.title: Operation Theatres
items.subtitle: Surgical facilities across multiple specialities.
items.body: IGCH's operation theatres support surgical procedures across its medical and surgical departments, including general and laparoscopic surgery, orthopaedics, cardiothoracic and vascular surgery, urology, ENT and surgical oncology.
items.note: [Number of operation theatres, equipment and additional surgical specialities to be confirmed.]

items.title: Blood Bank
items.subtitle: Blood and blood components for patient care.
items.body: The hospital's blood bank supports transfusion requirements for emergencies, surgeries and planned treatment.
items.note: [Available blood components, operating hours, licensing details and contact information to be provided.]

dialysis.heading: Making dialysis care more accessible.
dialysis.body: We provide haemodialysis services for patients with kidney failure. The hospital has also provided more than 7,000 free dialysis sessions to economically disadvantaged patients.

ctas.label: Explore our dialysis centre in Kochi

head.heading: Insurance & TPA Support
head.lead: Help with insurance approvals and hospital payments. IGCH works with insurance companies and Third-Party Administrators (TPAs) to facilitate cashless treatment for eligible patients. The hospital's insurance desk assists patients and families with pre-authorisation, documentation and insurance-related enquiries.

steps.title: Check eligibility
steps.body: Confirm your policy or scheme covers the treatment.

steps.title: Share documents
steps.body: Health insurance card or CGHS card, as applicable, valid photo ID, previous medical reports and investigation results, and a referral letter (for CGHS patients).

steps.title: Pre-authorisation
steps.body: Our desk coordinates approval with your insurer or TPA.

steps.title: Cashless care
steps.body: Treatment proceeds, with claims settled directly.

insurance.note: Cashless treatment is subject to policy coverage, terms and approval from the insurer or TPA.

canteen.heading: Food and essential services within the hospital campus.
canteen.body: The hospital canteen serves meals and refreshments for patients' families, bystanders, visitors and hospital staff.

cta.heading: Visiting IGCH? See the full patient & visitor guide.

paragraphs: Established in 1971, Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital (IGCH) was founded on the belief that quality healthcare should be accessible to everyone, irrespective of wealth.
Located at Kadavanthra, Kochi, IGCH has grown into a multispeciality hospital serving patients from Kochi, Ernakulam and neighbouring districts of Kerala.

services.heading: Diagnostic & Imaging Services
paragraphs: Investigations and imaging to support diagnosis.

IGCH's Radiology and Imaging department, including Interventional Radiology and its Microbiology laboratory, supports doctors across different departments in assessing medical conditions and planning treatment.

cards.title: Tests, hours and appointments
paragraphs: [Detailed list of imaging services, laboratory tests, operating hours and appointment requirements to be provided by the hospital.]

services.heading: Rehabilitation & Supportive Care
paragraphs: Care that continues beyond medical treatment.

Recovery and long-term health management may require support beyond consultations and medication. IGCH offers clinical support services to address patients' physical, nutritional and psychological needs.

cards.title: Physiotherapy
paragraphs: Physiotherapy services support rehabilitation, mobility and recovery following illness, injury or surgery.

cards.title: Dietetics
paragraphs: Dietary guidance to help patients manage nutritional requirements in line with their medical conditions and treatment plans.

cards.title: Clinical Psychology
paragraphs: Psychological assessment and support for patients who need help managing emotional and psychological concerns.

cards.title: Pain & Palliative Care
paragraphs: Support for patients living with serious or long-term illnesses, with attention to pain management, symptom relief and quality of life.

services.heading: Pharmacy
paragraphs: The hospital pharmacy serves patients who need prescribed medicines as part of their treatment and ongoing care.
Patients and their families can approach the pharmacy for information about prescription availability and medicine-related enquiries.

more.heading: Additional facilities
paragraphs: IGCH also provides facilities to support patients and visitors during their hospital visits.

cards.title: Patient Waiting Areas
paragraphs: Waiting spaces for patients' families and visitors.

cards.title: Parking
paragraphs: Parking arrangements for patients and visitors. Wallet parking is also available.

cards.title: Help Desk & Admission Support
paragraphs: Assistance with hospital enquiries, department directions and admission procedures.

cards.title: Billing & Payment Assistance
paragraphs: Guidance on billing, payment procedures and related enquiries.
